papers.title: Osseointegration of Alkali-Modified NANOZR Implants: An In Vivo Study.
papers.abstract: Ingredients and surface modification methods are being continually developed to improve osseointegration of dental implants and reduce healing times. In this study, we demonstrate in vitro that, by applying concentrated alkali treatment to NANOZR with strong bending strength and fracture toughness, a significant improvement in the bone differentiation of rat bone marrow cells can be achieved. We investigated the influence of materials modified with this treatment in vivo, on implanted surrounding tissues using polychrome sequential fluorescent labeling and micro-computer tomography scanning. NANOZR implant screws in the alkali-treated group and the untreated group were evaluated after implantation in the femur of Sprague⁻Dawley male rats, indicating that the amount of new bone in the alkali-modified NANOZR was higher than that of unmodified NANOZR. Alkali-modified NANOZR implants proved to be useful for the creation of new implant materials.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该研究涉及种植体骨整合，但未涉及LPBF制造、多孔结构或应力屏蔽分析，与用户研究方向不直接相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not involve LPBF fabrication, porous structure design, stress shielding, or mechanical testing (static or fatigue).

summary_zh.motivation: 探索碱处理NANOZR种植体对骨整合的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对大鼠股骨植入碱处理与未处理NANOZR种植体，通过荧光标记和micro-CT评估骨形成。
summary_zh.result: 碱处理组新骨量高于未处理组。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether alkali treatment of high-strength NANOZR implants enhances osseointegration.
summary_en.method: Alkali-modified NANOZR screws were implanted in rat femurs and bone formation was assessed by sequential fluorescent labeling and micro-CT.
summary_en.result: Alkali treatment led to significantly higher new bone volume compared to untreated NANOZR.
summary_en.validation: In vivo animal study with histomorphometry and micro-CT.
